description: This file defines an Android Service called LocalService that runs in the same process as the application. It manages a notification to indicate its running state, handles binding through a Binder class, and demonstrates interactions with system services like NotificationManager, Toast, and logging. The implementation includes lifecycle methods such as onCreate, onStartCommand, onDestroy, and onBind.

classes.name: LocalService
classes.description: An Android Service implementation that provides binding to clients, manages a persistent notification during its lifecycle, and demonstrates local service interactions.

classes.name: LocalBinder
classes.description: A Binder subclass that provides clients with access to the LocalService instance.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, obtains NotificationManager, and displays a notification indicating the service has started.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles start requests; logs received intent and start ID.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels the notification and shows a Toast indicating the service has stopped.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder for clients to interact with the service.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Builds and shows a notification indicating the service is running, with an intent to launch an activity on click.
